name: check_answer
description: Check the learner's confirmed answer once their confidence is recorded. Call it before saying anything about whether the answer is right. Returns the verdict (correct, incorrect, unverifiable or invalid_item) and a diagnostic when there is one. correct_answer, explanation and misconception appear only when the server has released them: after a correct answer, or for the learner to judge an unverifiable one. After an incorrect answer the question stays open: the learner may try again, ask for a hint or give up.
